module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Synchronous top-level integrator that wires the streaming controller, CSR/MMIO block, actuator validator, and bounded history wrapper without redefining ports or hierarchy.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Use simple top-level fanout and signal routing to connect CSR-programmed policy, transport status, and actuator safety inhibit paths; unsafe conditions suppress actuator validity rather than substituting commands.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Minimal top-level coordination state only, with all substantive sequencing, fault latching, and validation state owned by child modules; reset returns the integrated design to safe/inhibit conditions.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive the required top-level request/response transport, CSR/MMIO handshake, actuator command outputs, and observability status directly from child-owned RTL signals so every output has a real driver.
ownership_notes: Owns the full synthesizable top integration point and preserves the exact module name, ports, and filename.
Must keep the external transport direction contract: request valid/data out, request ready in; response valid/data in, response ready out.
Must expose a real firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface; the register contract is authoritative for software reachability.
Must not generate a substitute actuator command on reset or unsafe conditions; it must inhibit/deassert act_cmd_valid and latch faults for software handling.
Technology-neutral history storage remains bounded and FPGA-friendly via the declared BRAM wrapper.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_stream_ctrl
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Packet-format and handshake sequencer for bounded 128-bit streaming transport.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: A small synchronous transaction tracker accepts one request at a time by default, optionally allowing depth-2 behavior when enabled, and compares inbound responses against outstanding transaction metadata.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Track outstanding transaction ID, accepted sequence, age counter, freshness, timeout, and invalid-packet flags with simple registered state and no complex FSM beyond the implied request/response gating.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Emit outbound request valid/data, drive response ready, and publish acceptance, outstanding ID, age, stale, timeout, and invalid indicators to the safety and CSR planes.
ownership_notes: Transports metadata only; it does not parse geometry or implement physics.
Enforces exact 128-bit packing/unpacking and handshake direction rules.
Late or mismatched responses are dropped and flagged; age and timeout counters advance synchronously.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_csr_mmio
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Firmware-visible synchronous CSR/MMIO decode block with direct register map implementation.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Decode the fixed 0x00/0x08/0x10/0x18/0x20/0x28 window, apply read/write and rw1c semantics, and expose configuration and sticky status to the rest of the design.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Hold configuration registers, sequence counters, and sticky fault bits in synchronous flops with clear-on-write-one behavior for selected fault bits.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Return read data and ready semantics for valid accesses, drive configuration outputs to downstream logic, and surface version/capability/status fields for software observability.
ownership_notes: All declared registers are reachable through RTL decode and are therefore software-visible.
Invalid access patterns are handled benignly with safe defaults and latched error reporting as described by the spec.
Does not expose inaccessible internal state as register-visible software contract.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_actuator_validator
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Simple safety validator and actuator code/position mapper with registered outputs.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Check intent mode and requested position against programmable clamp limits and safety indicators; if unsafe, deassert validity instead of substituting a different command.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Use only minimal registered output state and clamp-status tracking; no elaborate FSM is implied beyond synchronous valid/inhibit behavior.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Produce compact actuator command code and position only when intent is valid and safety conditions are satisfied, otherwise drive validity low and report clamp/safety inhibit status.
ownership_notes: Prefers rejection/inhibit when safety is ambiguous.
No fallback command is generated on unsafe conditions; validity is simply deasserted.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_history_store
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Technology-neutral bounded RAM wrapper intended for FPGA block RAM inference.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Capture recent transaction context and supervision data through a small, synchronous memory interface without flattening bulk storage into registers.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Rely on the memory wrapper plus minimal write/read control state; storage depth remains bounded and consistent with sequencing policy.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Provide readback data for internal supervision/debug while remaining synthesis-friendly for FPGA flows.
ownership_notes: Implements only bounded history storage, not a general-purpose memory subsystem.
Must not infer ASIC SRAM macros or any Sky130 macro in the FPGA path.
Supports transaction metadata retention for freshness, sequencing, and observability.

sequencing_notes: Default outstanding-request depth is 1; depth 2 is only permitted when the CSR-controlled depth mode enables it.
Request age increments while a request is outstanding and is compared against programmable timeout/freshness thresholds.
Accepted sequence counters and outstanding IDs are tracked synchronously and published to CSR/status outputs.
Response matching is based on transaction ID and freshness checks; mismatches and late arrivals are dropped and flagged.
Sticky timeout, stale, invalid-packet, and clamp-violation conditions are latched for software handling until cleared through CSR semantics.
timing_notes: All logic is synchronous to clk with active-low synchronous reset_n as specified.
No asynchronous combinational feedback is introduced in control decisions.
Registered actuator outputs update synchronously and are expected to align with act_cmd_ready semantics as implemented within the bounded top-level intent.
History storage is technology-neutral and intended for FPGA RAM inference only.
consistency_notes: No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
